title_sq: Ne Paskuqan, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Vendndodhje Dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Ne Paskuqan, ne nje Kompleks te Ri, Buze Rruges Kryesore, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri dhe Vendndodhje Perfekte shume afer Unazes se Madhe !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 105 m², ndodhet ne katin e dyte banim dhe organizohet ne korridorin shperndares, dhomen e ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, ku njera dhome eshte me dalje ne ballkon, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon. Aktualisht eshte ne fazen e instalimeve dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda Shtatorit 2026. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug, dhe shikon nga unaza e madhe dhe qyteti i Tiranes. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Kompleksi ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per cilesine e punimeve dhe eshte nje nder komplekset me te mira te zones.
title_en: In Paskuqan, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect location and orientation!!
description_en: In Paskuqan, in a new complex, on the edge of the main street, 2+1 apartment for sale, with a perfect layout and location, very close to the Great Ring Road!! The apartment with a gross area of ​​105 m², is located on the second residential floor and is organized in a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, one of which has access to the balcony, a bathroom and a balcony. It is currently in the installation phase and is expected to be completed by September 2026. The orientation of the apartment is south, and looks at the big ring and the city of Tirana. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The complex in which the apartment is located stands out for the quality of the works and is one of the best complexes in the area.
